csharpDecision: Expressions.Core.cs EmitDictionaryLiteral calls EmitExpression for each key/value. EmitNameExpression resolves the authoritative RuntimeValue in _locals (loading a RuntimeReference when needed). GenericDictionary.cs EmitBoundedInlineDictionaryLiteral passes those values to EmitInlineDictionaryPut; it never invents an SSA name from a syntax index. Current CSharp10 operand and5 index controls pass.
slgBefore: foundation.slg emitBoundedDictionaryLiteralOperand has a bounded-array value special case, direct integer/Bool literal emission, then returns %v<valueNameId> for every other operand. A primary generic Item argument is already available as %arg, and no %v5 definition exists in the failed function.
slgDecision: Preserve bounded-array value materialization. Materialize a unique operand prefix with freeze using writeAggregateFieldTypeId (fixed-array storage is %sollang.int_slice). Reuse writeDictionaryLiteralItem, which handles integer/Bool literals and delegates other values to writeFunctionValueName. That existing writer selects %arg for a primary value and emitted SSA names for locals/calls/materialized scalar references. No new fallback or duplicated parameter matching.
